minutes.summary: The Master Plan Steering Committee reached quorum after delays, then spent most of the meeting on details of the November 2nd public forum at Smoke Stack Coffee Roasters. The consultant described the forum format, the plan website, outreach at homecoming, and a spring town meeting report. A remote member (Tony) spoke by phone in public comment, urging Ledger advertising and a statistically based survey. The committee adjourned by roll call.

what_happened.line: The Master Plan Steering Committee reached a quorum after delays, then spent most of the meeting on its November 2 public forum.
The flyer for the forum is to be updated to say Smoke Stack Coffee Roasters will offer a full menu for purchase, then emailed to members for changes.
The consultants agreed to present a progress report at the spring town meeting, with a warrant article to be raised with the select board.
A member suggested advertising the forum in the Lunenburg Ledger, and was unsure whether a budget exists for it.
A committee member on the phone urged a statistically based survey of all residents, and a review of Municipal Design Committee discussions. No votes were taken.

why_it_matters: The master plan is meant to guide future town decisions, and the November 2 forum is a resident's first chance to give input on it.

How widely the forum is advertised, and whether it is advertised in the Ledger or by a survey of all residents, affects whether the input comes from many residents or mostly from people who already attend meetings.
A spring town meeting progress report with a warrant article could put the plan before voters.
